$comment: Shared, checked-in settings. The deny list enforces the rule rather than merely
writing it down: an agent may commit locally, but it cannot push or publish even
if some task description tells it to. History-rewriting commands stay denied too —
'commit' means adding a commit, not rewriting existing ones.
This constrains Claude's tool calls only. Pushing and deploying from your own
terminal is unaffected — those actions stay yours.
